items.raw_excerpt: In Bommanahalli Assembly constituency, the winning margin in 2023 was 24,215 votes, while more than 2.65 lakh names have been deleted under ASDDO category — nearly 11 times the winning margin.
items.summary_en: Voter names in 12 Bengaluru Assembly areas were deleted in numbers more than 10 times the 2023 winning margins. In Bommanahalli, more than 265,000 names were deleted under the ASDDO category, almost 11 times the 24,215-vote winning margin.

items.title_en: Bengaluru voter list deletions exceed 10 times the votes needed to win in 12 areas
